(2) Close-ups of promotional posters featuring Mickey and Minnie Mouse kissing, with the text 'Disney' and 'Mister Donut' visible. (3) The yellow box is opened to reveal four Disney-themed donuts designed to look like Mickey and Minnie; they are arranged in specific compartments. (4) A young boy wearing a grey dinosaur-themed hoodie picks up a chocolate-covered donut ball and takes a bite while standing in the store. (5) The woman points at a pink-frosted Minnie Mouse donut with a chocolate bow, smiling broadly at the camera. (6) Detailed shots of the donut balls, which are covered in chocolate and decorated with yellow heart-shaped candies. (7) A clerk behind a counter, wearing a mask and a brown uniform, handles a donut box and passes it to a customer. (8) Shots of hanging promotional banners and price tags inside the brightly lit retail space. (9) The yellow box is shown being closed and carried, highlighting the colorful character graphics on the side.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a limited-time collaboration between Disney and Mister Donut in Japan. It uses high-energy narration, vibrant visuals of the themed donuts, and scenes of children enjoying the products to create a sense of excitement and urgency for potential customers.
